data.title: Advanced Matrix Multiplication and Linear Transformations
data.description: Students will practice rigorous row-by-column dot products to compute composite linear transformations across a sequence of progressive challenges.

challenges.instruction: Multiply A (2×2) by B (2×2). Enter each entry of the 2×2 result.
challenges.hint: Result[i][j] = row i of A · column j of B = Σ A[i][k] × B[k][j].

challenges.instruction: Multiply A (2×3) by B (3×2). Enter each entry of the 2×2 result.
challenges.hint: Result[i][j] = row i of A · column j of B = Σ A[i][k] × B[k][j].

data.educationalContext: Matrix multiplication is foundational to modern computational mathematics, serving as the algebraic backbone for computer graphics, cryptography, and high-dimensional data analysis in machine learning.
